title.ko: 집 설명하기: there is / are · 비교 · 정중한 문의
title.en: describing housing: there is / are, comparisons, polite enquiries

explain.ko: 집을 구할 때는 there is / there are로 시설을 말하고(There are two bedrooms), 비교급으로 조건을 비교합니다(It's cheaper than the other flat). 문의할 때는 Could I ...? / Is it possible to ...?로 정중하게 말하고, 가격은 The rent is ... a month로 말합니다. 월세는 rent, 보증금은 deposit, 포함 여부는 (not) included로 말하며, 집을 구하는 사람은 tenant, 주인은 landlord입니다.
explain.en: When you look for a home, use there is / there are for facilities (There are two bedrooms) and comparatives to compare options (It's cheaper than the other flat). Ask politely with Could I ...? / Is it possible to ...? and state the price with The rent is ... a month. Rent is the monthly payment; the deposit is paid in advance; things can be (not) included. The person who rents is the tenant and the owner is the landlord.
